activation: When asked to run this handoff, execute the referenced plan through reviewed, executed completion evidence. Writing this draft does not start implementation.
resume_prompt: Run work/harness-review/test-traceability/handoff-draft.json. Implement its referenced JSON plan in dependency order, review the tests against the spec, execute the required unit/integration/E2E cases and report per-criterion evidence. Commit meaningful steps and provide concrete progress updates.

repository.branch_rule: Continue the existing related work branch; preserve later descendants and the later inbox.

prior_verification.meaning: Existing repository checks passed at the planning commit; this is not execution evidence for the proposed 18 test scenarios.

existing_r1_r2.preserve: Keep existing candidate-verification, locking, recovery and FF-only integration behavior and historical evidence.

references_on_demand.policy: Read _ask/policies/delegation.md, risk.md, verification.md, worktree.md, workflow.md and git-flow.md before execution.
references_on_demand.stages: Read the relevant .agents/ask/stages/ contract before each stage; prepare its required artifact.
references_on_demand.examples: contracts.example.json and coverage.example.py beside this file illustrate the design. EXAMPLE_* placeholders are never actual evidence; the Python sketch is not an integrated validator.
references_on_demand.existing_runtime: Read _ask/docs/inner-loop-evidence.md before changing candidate verification, review bindings, integration or recovery.

canonical_authority.requirement_ids: TT-001 through TT-011 in the proposal
canonical_authority.test_inventory: 18 BDD scenarios in plan.json: U01-U07, I01-I09, E01-E02
canonical_authority.rule: Use the detailed requirements, file ownership, dependencies, tests and exit criteria in plan.json. This handoff supplies resume context rather than a second implementation specification.

startup.action: Inspect Git status, current branch and baseline ancestry; run ./ask check-clean. Preserve all descendants and resolve any dirty paths using their known ownership and session authorization.
startup.done_when: The intended branch is selected, its history is understood and the worktree is clean.

startup.action: Read the ordered inputs and relevant policies. Announce that this is a clear continuation of the existing plan. Record Explore skipped: destination already clear. in the scoped intent artifact.
startup.done_when: The next task is explicitly P01 and prior R1/R2 completion is distinguished from the unimplemented traceability feature.

startup.action: Use already pinned skills; run ./ask prepare and ./ask sync. Preserve unrelated prepared content and commit any intentional preparation changes before implementation. ./ask setup remains human-only.
startup.done_when: Preparation and bindings are current and the tree is clean.

startup.action: Execute P01 through the existing Spec Change and independent Spec Challenge flow. The proposal is still planning-only: record the accepted contract identity before production changes. Carry existing user authorization forward without requesting repeated Plan/Review permission. Prepare required stage artifacts as short JSON pointers where appropriate, preserving the original R1/R2 records.
startup.done_when: Challenge findings are resolved, the scoped accepted spec and required plan artifact exist, and the JSON plan references exactly that accepted spec revision. Material requirement changes remain explicit.

implementation_loop.order: P01 -> P02 -> P03 -> P04 -> P05 -> P06 -> P07, respecting plan.json exit criteria
steps: Select the next dependency-ready task and its requirement IDs and planned cases.
For new or changed behavior, write and execute a meaningful failing assertion before production changes; retain the actual red revision and output.
Implement the smallest behavior needed, run the required cases green, then refactor and rerun affected tests.
Commit each meaningful step on agent/harness-review without waiting for a commit request.
Record task evidence against the actual candidate revision, then advance only when task exit criteria hold.
implementation_loop.implementation_style: Versioned JSON metadata and shared typed Python logic; thin existing shell entrypoints and concise stage pointers. Preserve consumer-owned YAML static checks.
implementation_loop.progress_feedback: At least every 60 seconds of ongoing work, state the actual task, finding or change, checks run and next concrete step. A generic Working indicator is insufficient.

review_and_evidence.semantic_review: An independent reviewer must inspect actual tests against every accepted criterion: required test types, observable Given/When/Then, assertions, realistic counterexamples and red/green assertion continuity.
review_and_evidence.execution: Run actual required unit, integration and E2E cases at the final source candidate. A true E2E case exercises the public workflow and a separate application process; a type label is insufficient.
review_and_evidence.mandatory_negative_flow: Unit passing while required E2E is omitted must fail Verify, task integration, acceptance checks and record-result pass. Also execute the stale-evidence, invalid-red, skipped/zero-case and scope-replay scenarios specified in the plan.
review_and_evidence.mandatory_positive_flow: Execute the real consumer-repository unit-plus-E2E flow and show both cases linked to their criterion with approved review and actual final green evidence.
review_and_evidence.final_suite: Run ./ask verify at the final source candidate, retain its SHA and logs, and record the result through the newly validated completion path.
review_and_evidence.report: For each TT criterion show required test types, exact test IDs, review decision, TDD red/green or authorized exemption, final outcome and retained execution artifacts.

completion.definition: All plan.json definition_of_done entries hold with actual code, independently reviewed assertions and executed evidence.
completion.limits: Structural metadata and passing commands alone do not establish semantic correctness. Historical planning checks and design examples cannot stand in for new feature evidence.
completion.resume_on_interruption: Commit recoverable progress, update session-resume.md with completed task IDs, source SHA, executed results, unresolved findings and the next concrete task. Preserve existing evidence and leave the tree clean.
completion.final_response: Report implemented behavior, per-criterion test evidence, independent review findings, full verification source SHA, commits and any remaining limitations.
